title: Jingzhe Exercise Sync API v1 input
description: Canonical source-owned exercise facts accepted by a self-hosted Jingzhe sync gateway.

schema_version.description: Breaking changes use a new schema version.

source.description: Stable upstream provider namespace that owns external_id, such as apple_health, keep or strava.

producer.description: Optional diagnostic identifier for the client or connector that produced this request, such as laodao_app. It is not part of activity identity.

mode.description: snapshot replaces the complete declared source and is only safe for a connector authoritative for that whole source; delta applies only explicit upserts and deletes and is required for device-local views.

request_id.description: Optional caller-generated correlation and diagnostic identifier. It is returned to the caller but is not persisted.

upsert.description: Activities to create or update by source plus external_id; in snapshot mode this is the complete source snapshot.

delete.description: Explicit external_id values to delete from this source in delta mode. Delta omission never deletes history.

external_id.description: Stable activity identifier inside the declared upstream source namespace.

name.description: Optional source or user supplied activity name.

started_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp with Z or an explicit UTC offset.

average_heartrate_bpm.description: Optional average heart rate in beats per minute.

elevation_gain_m.description: Optional total elevation gain in metres.

is_indoor.description: Indoor activities cannot include a route and may be unavailable or temporarily pending.

route_status.description: The source adapter decides privacy before upload. Only available may include a real route.

summary_polyline.description: Google encoded polyline with precision 5; allowed only for available routes.

x-jingzhe-contract.source_semantics: source is the upstream provider namespace that owns external_id; producer is only the sending app or connector.
x-jingzhe-contract.source_switch: Records from different source namespaces are distinct. Never fuzzy-deduplicate by time, distance, heart rate or route; use an explicit cutoff or migration mapping when changing providers.

sync_modes.snapshot: Atomically replaces the declared source and may be empty; only an authoritative full-source export may use it.
sync_modes.delta: Applies explicit upserts and deletes; omission never deletes history. New phones and other device-local clients must use delta even for their first full read.

x-jingzhe-contract.multi_device_source: Multiple devices may share one provider namespace. A device must upsert what it can currently see and delete only provider-confirmed deleted IDs; absence from one device is never deletion evidence.
x-jingzhe-contract.privacy_boundary: The adapter must remove the real polyline before sending privacy_hidden. The gateway validates this invariant but cannot infer whether an available route should have been private.
x-jingzhe-contract.compatibility: Existing required fields, identity, units and semantics are immutable in v1; breaking changes require schema_version 2.
